body.statement: For every observed law \(P\in\mathcal M\) and every full-data law \(P^{\mathrm F}\) witnessing its membership, consistency, conditional exchangeability, strict overlap, continuity of the smooth observed regression version \(m\), and the maintained version convention \(\texttt{ass:potential-mean-continuity}\) imply \(\mu^{\mathrm F}(a,w)=m(a,w)\) for every \(a\in[0,1]\) and almost every \(w\) under the observed \(W\)-marginal. Consequently, for every \(a\in J\), \(\mathbb E_{P^{\mathrm F}}[Y(a)]=\theta(a)=\int m(a,w)p(w)\,dw\), so every admissible full-data extension of the same observed \(P\) agrees on the exact-dose causal curve over \(J\).
body.justification: This isolates the maintained continuous-version convention needed to identify a causal mean at every exact dose rather than only for almost every dose; the convention is not part of the excursion argument.
body.gap: Westling, Gilbert, and Carone (2020) develop the causal-isotonic estimand and identification framework; the exact jointly measurable continuous conditional-potential-mean version imposed here is an additional maintained convention rather than a condition attributed to that paper.
body.consumer: It gives the AHA/CMS nurse-hours profile and its threshold doses a causal interpretation under the maintained conditions.
